fields.title: Please, Don't Touch Anything
fields.description:
Please, Don’t Touch Anything is a cryptic, brain-racking button-pushing simulation.

Covering for a colleague who is taking a bathroom break, you find yourself in front of a mysterious panel which only component is a red button. And since you’ve clearly been instructed not to touch anything, the only thing you want to do now is push that damn button.

Push it and expect to be held liable for any unintended aftermath. And there will be many.

fields.description: Santa and his helpers have been kidnapped! Mysterious aliens are plotting to destroy the holidays. Fortunately, all is not lost. Take on the role of a brave Snowman – the last defender of Christmas in a dynamic 2D platformer with arcade combat. Bring back the magic of Christmas!

fields.title: Marippy
fields.description: Marippy is a Touhou fan game based on the arcade game Mappy. The game has the player play as Marisa Kirisame as she collects items from Alice Margatroid's house which Alice had stole.

fields.title: Yakuza 0: Digital Deluxe Edition
fields.description: Yakuza 0 is an action-adventure game developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio and published by Sega. Serving as a prequel to the Yakuza series, it is set in 1988 Japan during the country's economic bubble era. The game follows two protagonists: Kazuma Kiryu in Tokyo's Kamurocho district and Goro Majima in Osaka's Sotenbori district. Players alternate between their stories as they navigate the criminal underworld, engaging in street fights, managing businesses, and participating in various side activiti

fields.title: No Legs? No Problem!
fields.description: Be the first to reach the goal in this intense 4 player racing game. Challenge your friends to a free for all or team up in an epic 2v2 race battle. Use your abilities to grief your enemies, or boost yourself to the finish line.

fields.title: Eclipse Survivors
fields.description: Experience the ultimate challenge in Eclipse Survivors, a bullet-hell / area shooter game featuring epic bosses inspired by classic 16-bit titles. Collect XP gems, master unique skills, and dodge countless enemy bullets as you face off against hordes of foes. Will you survive the eclipse?

fields.title: Gesshizu: Gajigaji Nakama wo Sodateyou
fields.description:
A game where you raise creatures hatched from eggs that can change based on how they are raised. What they eat and where they are can affect this.
You take pictures of them in various situations to complete challenges and earn rewards while filling out an encyclopedia of all the different variations available.

fields.title: Space Haven
fields.description: Embark on a space journey with your patched-together crew of civilians in search of a new home. Build spaceships tile by tile, create optimal gas conditions, manage the needs and moods of their crew, encounter other space-faring groups, and explore the universe in this spaceship colony sim.

fields.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
fields.description: Lead the members of Expedition 33 on their quest to destroy the Paintress so that she can never paint death again. Explore a world of wonders inspired by Belle Époque France and battle unique enemies in this turn-based RPG with real-time mechanics.

fields.title: Candy Arkanoid
fields.description: Candy Arkanoid is more than just a simple arcade game - it also includes role-playing elements, allowing players to level up their candy Arkanoid and customize its abilities So why wait? Satisfy your sweet tooth and soon blast your way through the candy cosmos!

fields.title: Survalker
fields.description: Hordes of unknown creatures emerge from the darkness, hunting for your soul. Gather artifacts, enhance your abilities, and search for a way out of this cursed place… if an escape even exists.

fields.title: 12 Labours of Hercules XI: Painted Adventure
fields.description: 12 Labours of Hercules XI: Painted Adventure is a casual puzzle, adventure game in which the young girl Emma finds herself in ancient Greece. Follow Emma as she helps Hercules on all of his adventures!

fields.title: Heroes & Redemption

fields.description: Use your fan to blow a balloon safely through each trap filled environment.

fields.description:
Heed the call of the open road, throw the gears in motion and take off in a tractor trailer. Drive faster than your competition, haul your cargo across the entire United States and feel the wind in your face as you control your own destiny. Blast the horn and build a career in the fast-paced world of trucking.

fields.description: A room escape game set in the magical world of Panmorphia. Wield the four elements and upgrade the amulet!

fields.description: Edessa: School of Wizardry is a dark themed action game set in a magical universe. Fight the demons that have plagued the world and cast your spells with the Edessa's unique spellcasting mechanic. Fight the bosses, solve the puzzles and come out on top.

fields.title: Rhythmic Keyboard
fields.description: Rhythmic Keyboard is a music-based typing game with integration of a talent system that allows for the player to increase their effectiveness. Procedurally spawned keys inhibit pattern formation, so reaction speed and hand/eye coordination are a priority -- not memorization.

fields.title: The Artefacts lost in the Galaxy
fields.description: You must find information about the stations infected by the extraterrestrials. You can kill the enemy, but also destroy annoying objects, push them, or use them to pass an obstacle. To succeed in your mission, you own a percussion gun and a fusion rifle.

You swing your paddle left and right in order to push the pieces towards the evacuation shafts, gaining some of that precious little time before the play area inevitably spills and it's game over.

fields.title: Glass Cannon
fields.description: Challenging and chill roguelike where you plan your shots carefully and creatively eliminate enemies using different weapon combinations. Buy weapon mods to create powerful synergies and clear all 24 rounds.

fields.title: Pocket Shooter Hardcore
fields.description:
Pocket Shooter Hardcore, a new 2017 free 3D action shooting game comes to mobile and tablets!

Mad Emoji arrive and prepare to invade earth. Machine Gun Boy is the only Hero who can resist and protect the planet. Grab the gun and stop this madness now! What are you waiting for, Machine Gun Boy?

Features:
Use machine gun, meteor rain, bombs or shield to defend yourself against Mad Emoji.

Fight against army of Angry Emoji.

Shoot enemies as quickly as possible and don’t let them to reach you.

fields.title: Kapsul Infinite
fields.description:
Pilot your tiny space capsule through an endless series of procedurally generated challenges. Physics-based action gameplay that is easy to learn, but very difficult to master. Try and try again as you soak up the soothing atmosphere and striking abstract visuals.

fields.title: Immortal Souls: Dark Crusade
fields.description: In this action RPG game you try to destroy the monsters of the underworld. You can use various attacks, which come together to form chains. This causes that their power multiplies.

fields.title: Deadly Rails
fields.description: Fight your way through the horde of undead and reach your goal. The only limits are your wits and determination.

fields.title: Divinest Light
fields.description: Divinest Light is an atmospheric puzzle-platformer set in the mysterious and dark world with a unique shadow-avoidance mechanic.

fields.title: Plane Crazy Championship Edition
fields.description: Get ready to experience high speed arcade-style racing action! Easy to learn…impossible to master! Your Goal: Earn the title of the quickest airborne Speed Freak! It will take a lot more than fancy flying, quick reactions, sheer nerve, and skill to win here…you gotta be Plane Crazy!

fields.title: The Shop of Good Memories
fields.description: The Shop of Good Memories was made for advxjam based on the theme "a good time". Take a look around the shop, browse some memories, and leave one of your own if you like.

fields.title: Admiral: Sea Battles
fields.description: Admiral: Sea Battles is a turn-based strategy game of naval warfare in the great Age of Sail. It was developed by Meridian'93 and published by Megamedia on September 30, 1996. Admiral: Sea Battles became the first commercial video game of independent Ukraine.

fields.title: Exmortis 2
fields.description: Exmortis II follows one of the last survivors, Mr. Hannay, who, following the words of an unknown entity at the resistance safe house, attempts to destroy the Cult of Exmortis once and for all.

fields.title: Nope Nope Nope Nope Nurses
fields.description: The thrilling final installment of Dark One!'s hit visual novel series! Hapless protagonist Yamada is once again at the mercy of the tender depredations of the world's worst staff of nurses... and this time, it's up close and personal with the ruthless Head Nurse who dominates all the rest!

fields.title: To Swat A Fly
fields.description: For four years, the Red Valley County in Arizona was haunted by a shadowy serial killer with mysterious methods of murder. Even three years after her arrest, the "Red Valley Reaper" Mel Atkinson has refused to speak a word to the press-- until today. You've managed to get yourself an exclusive interview with the high-profile prisoner. The question is-- can you ask the right questions and make it out with the truth?

fields.title: Beventlaed
fields.description: Beventlaed is a singleplayer Touhou puzzle fangame in which you have to connect strings of three identically colored UFOs. Red colored UFOs extend your life meter, blue UFOs increase you score multiplie and the green ones intrease your Bomb meter, which helps you get rid of glass UFOs (which normally can only be gotten rid of by connecting adjacent UFOs).

fields.title: Super Ghouls'n Ghosts
fields.description: As dauntless knight Arthur you are caught up in the most dangerous of quests! A spell has been cast upon the kingdom. Your fair maiden, Princess Prin Prin has been snatched up by the evil emperor. Only as Arthur can you get her back from the creatures of the undead that haunt the land. Test your courage and skill to the limit. You must keep up the quest. On your journey, your mightiest weapon of all awaits you... MAGIC!

fields.description: Apastron is a retro styled open world FPS set on the planet of Coelho #6. You're a defender reborn every generation. Your overseer restores you (Phoebe Harper) to discover the origins of Coelho's unknown threat.

fields.title: Tenacious
fields.description: Tenacious is a fast-paced rogue-lite dungeon crawler with a heavy emphasis on loot. Tear your way through levels and swap gear on the fly to change your abilities. Loot rare items to enhance your abilities. Spend your gold at the forge to create your own play style.

fields.title: Exo Wanderers
fields.description: This is a sci-fi top-down tank shooting game that can be played solo or with two players. As human civilization is on the brink of extinction, you will take on the role of one or two "Exo Wanderers," seeking the truth of the Galactic and Earth civilizations on Gliese 667Ce.

The game features a single-player campaign with 20 missions across multiple difficulty levels, emphasizing stealth, varied objectives and mission-based progression. Players can use a range of weapons and gadgets while navigating diverse environments inspired by the movie.

Bee and Flower is a single-screen arcade game. You control a honeybee who, over the course of a day, has to visit flowers at the bottom of the screen and return the nectar to the hive at the top of the screen.

fields.title: Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time
fields.description:
Deceived by the treacherous Vizier, I was led to unleash the Sands of Time curse upon the Sultan's kingdom. With little but an ancient dagger and a devious princess to aid me, I must undo my fatal mistake. Mine is a fight for survival… not glory.

• Reverse, accelerate, and slow time itself with the almighty Sands of Time.
• Master the Prince's speed, agility, and ferocious fighting skills.
• Explore and survive the vast kingdoms of medieval Persia.

fields.description: This is the final game in the "Lord of Darkness" trilogy in the genre of old JRPGs with a turn-based combat system. As in the previous installments, the dramatic story is skillfully combined with parody and satirical notes. These are difficult times.

fields.title: In a Bit of Tales
fields.description: In a Bit of Tales is a unique horror anthology game featuring seven spine-chilling stories delivered in an omakase-style experience. Explore haunting dreams, mysterious cults, ghostly schools, and more!

fields.title: Alone: Shattered Tribes
fields.description: An isometric survival RPG without the survival. Collect resources and craft items and weapons. Build a settlement on your island. Hunt in the darkest forests, or slay the undead in the cursed crypts. Explore the islands, unite the shattered tribes, and become a Jarl worthy of the sagas.

fields.title: The Music at the End of the World
fields.description: "What music would you listen to at the end of the world?" Explore an abandoned world after the apocalypse of the final winter. Shape the story of a man whose loneliness threatens his sanity. Use violence to survive or avoid it to protect your mind. Experience the end of the world!

fields.title: One-liners
fields.description: One-liners is a modern take on the classic dots and boxes game traditionally played with pen and paper. The goal is to create more complete boxes than your opponent by taking turns to draw horizontal or vertical lines between adjacent dots. However, there are new possibilities for strategizing and defeating your opponents, such as items that can be activated on the board.

fields.title: Radical Fishing
fields.description:
Radical Fishing is an Adobe Flash-based game where a fisherman sits in a boat and casts his line into the water, pulls up fish into the air, and shoots them with a gun.

Vlambeer sold the Flash game to a browser games website in 2010 but kept the rights to produce a sequel for iOS, which they called Ridiculous Fishing.

fields.title: Lock On
fields.description: Lock On is a roulette game developed by Hypa Soft for PC-8000/PC-8800.

fields.title: PGA Tour 2K23: Deluxe Edition
fields.description:
The Deluxe Edition contains:
- The Standard Edition
- The Michael Jordan Bonus Pack
- Deluxe Bonus Pack

fields.title: Vesper
fields.description: Thousands of years after the activation of the Vesper Protocol, a small android crosses a fallen world, hunted by merciless machines, to control the power of Light and decide the fate of his race.

fields.title: Lazy Galaxy: Rebel Story
fields.description:
An old robot named H-34-RT wakes up in a derelict space station orbiting his home planet. His civilization was destroyed long ago by evil O'Xelg, but he has yet to figure that out. After an initial shock, he decides to follow his old defense routines: that means fighting the invaders, even if he is alone now.

Start your exciting adventure in the SUPER STORM!
The game combines parkour, fast pacing, epic soundtrack and dangerous traps in the destroyed worlds from the apocalypse!

You will experience the full danger of a global catastrophe in the first person.

In search of a new world between portals, you have to go through a difficult path consisting of deadly traps, ferocious dinosaurs and boiling lava.

Test your skills in time dilation zones, acceleration boosters and trampoline jumpings.

fields.title: Gilligan's Gold
fields.description: Gilligan's Gold is a flick-screen platform game based on the arcade game Bagman consisting of three screens as you try to negotiate various levels of a mine to collect all the bags of gold scattered around the three screens. Trying to stop you are a couple of outlaws and if you touch one then you lose one of five lives. fields.title: Abyss Pact
fields.description: Abyss Pact is an adventure fighting RPG,where you become a talented heroic warrior to protect the last remaining pure land, and embark on your own legendary path!

fields.title: Time Snatcher Handy
fields.description: The universe's greatest cat burglar? The ultimate phantom thief across dimensions? Nah... Time Snatcher Handy, that's me! A time-stop bullet-hell action roguelike starring "Handy" the stylish cat burglar! Stop the time to dodge bullets, gather items to get stronger, and escape the Time Museum!

fields.title: Bionic Heart
fields.description:
London, 2099. The earth isn't what it used to be anymore. Incredible climate changes have corrupted the weather, causing a permanent rain on most of the Earth's surface.
You play the role of Luke Black, a 36-year-old bio-informatic engineer. He is one of the lead programmers at Nanotech, a big nanotechnology research company.
But one night, his life is changed forever when he encounters Tanya. Who is she? What does she wants from Luke?

fields.title: Fillit
fields.description: Filit is a frantic 1 to 4 player casual action game based and inspired by the nostalgic Xonix and Volfied adding a unique mechanics and new gameplay. Grab your areas while avoiding your enemies and bad bosses.

fields.title: Monster Evolution
fields.description: Play as a monster. Create havoc, feed on humans, and evolve into 25 different monsters!

fields.title: TU-46
fields.description: TU-46 is a sequel to the game TU-95. This time around you control a 1970s airline. You get to control the brand new passenger aircrafts from Tupolev. Deliver passengers around 6 countries, use upgrades to improve your plane's stability and try to shine in the daily newspaper, every airline has its deadline, be the last one to stick around.

fields.title: Meet'N'Fuck Threesome Fun
fields.description: It's happened last summer. My good friend Chris was walking around the town. He's seen two pretty ladies staying in the rays of sun. Usually modest, at this time he stepped up and took on a challenge. Want to know what happened next? Let's play this dirty adventure.

fields.title: Single City
fields.description:
Meet social Friends. Love dreamy Avatars! Style a modern Designer Home interior!

Welcome to Single City, a unique strategy and life simulation game, where metaverse FAME is the ultimate goal!

Flirt, flex, and flaunt your way through encounters in this big city sim. Collab with your social network to cause drama for your rivals as you compete for followers. More friends and followers means more clout, which means more influence to link with the love of your life!

fields.title: Tower Of Wishes 3: Japan
fields.description: Tower of Wishes 3: Japan is a match 3 game that tells the story of Ryu, a skilled ninja who is on the run, being pursued by his own clan. Unable to shake off the relentless pursuit, Ryu decides to seek his destiny in climbing the Tower Of Wishes.

fields.title: Ink Link
fields.description: Ink Link is a sleek world of action in 2.5D! Outsmart enemies, piece together platforms, and upgrade your skills to take on powerful bosses. Discover hidden paths as darkness creeps in and your ally-turned-enemy, Ink, tests your skills—and your will to survive.

fields.title: Hold.for.Humans
fields.description: Hold the line so that humanity may live another day. Defend the evacuation lanes from the relentless spawns of a rogue AI in this rhythm/roguelite-infused hack n’ slash/tower defense game. Upgrade the last friendly robot on Earth, armed with a unwavering program and purpose: HOLD.FOR.HUMANS.

fields.title: Welcome to QiQu Club
fields.description: Tired of a suffocating college routine? Yearning for something more? Join the Qiqu Club! We promise unforgettable experiences beyond your wildest dreams. But beware, our club is extremely exclusive. Only those daring enough to seek adventure will be admitted...

fields.title: Rude Racers
fields.description: Rude Racers offers exciting bike racing with crazy fighting action, mad weapons and fast gameplay! Play through a tremendous variety of innovative challenges and establish yourself as the meanest racer on the street in this smashing new pick-up-and-play racer!

fields.title: RollerCoaster Tycoon Adventures
fields.description: RollerCoaster Tycoon Adventures brings the RollerCoaster series into the next generation - combining classic RTC gameplay with the modernized user experience from the mobile game RollerCoaster Tycoon Touch. The game also has unique features that fits on Nintendo Switch!

fields.description: Propulsion is a fast-paced 3D platformer inspired by the rocket jumping mechanic that has featured in many other games. The aim is for the player to use their rocket launcher to rocket jump across the levels as fast as possible, flying through a variety of environments, each featuring their own mechanics to spice up the gameplay.

fields.description: This is a game which the players can control the main character to push the box. Push the box to the designated area to pass the level.

fields.description: Use three types of weapon to take out the hordes of micro enemies.

fields.title: Holomento
fields.description:
Holomento is an indie permadeath RPG focusing on the dangerous quest of passing through the mysterious Eventide Hollow – and rebuilding it step by step.

Explore a hand-crafted open world featuring procedurally generated dungeons!
Fight your way through Eventide Hollow – again and again!
Rebuild the Hollow and release it from its ruinous curse!

fields.title: Sneaky Seekers
fields.description: Sneak into the shadows and, using your pickaxe, try to find the treasure hidden around the map, but beware: you're not alone, and your friends will do anything to get in your way! So be the smartest, and strike first.

fields.title: Date the Difference
fields.description: Date the Difference is a casual puzzle game where you spot differences between images while enjoying a light dating-themed atmosphere. Explore stylish scenes, find hidden details, earn rewards, and unlock charming characters through relaxing, attention-based gameplay.

fields.title: Golfslinger
fields.description:
An explosive mix of golf and shooting! Use a varied arsenal to launch your ball into a frantic multiplayer chaos!

Be the world best in the racing solo races or face off against up to 12 players in stylized Westernpunk environments and prove you're the best of the Golfslingers!

A game made for tryharder and having fun with your friends !

He can also attack by throwing his fists, or winding up his fists for a more powerful punch. He can occasionally find special power ups that grant him unlimited flying power, giving him the ability to navigate through tricky mazes.

Up to eight players may participate and the computer can control any free players. The game is turn-based so you only need one computer to play the game with up to seven friends.

Conquest of Elysium was originally released in 1996 for the Atari Falcon line of computers. The number "II" denotes the version number.

The story is centered around a delivery mission by sail ship, its purpose being to deliver war technology to a town defending itself against attackers. Player character is the stealth expert of the crew, doing missions involving stealing, spying and sabotage.

fields.description: Call of Cthulhu: Darkness Within is an adventure game inspired by the writings of H. P. Lovecraft developed for mobile phones. The game takes place in Cairo in the 1930s. fields.title: NES Classics
fields.description: NES Classics was a flash game featuring a slide puzzle to promote the Classic NES Series; a collection of NES games rereleased on Game Boy Advance. The completed puzzle features art from Dr. Mario, Castelvania, Zelda II: The Adventure of Link, and Metroid.

fields.title: Endless TV Tycoon
fields.description:
Ever wondered how TV shows come to life and networks thrive? Endless TV Tycoon puts you in the driver’s seat of the entire process!

From writing scripts, running auditions, and shooting episodes to editing, test-screening, and scheduling shows, you’re in charge. Build your network by approving pilots, renewing hits, canceling flops, and managing ad contracts—all while outsmarting the competition.

Think you’ve got what it takes to be the ultimate TV Manager? Let’s find out!

fields.description:
You are left alone to manage an old clothing store and deal with the customers...

It’s closing time at the local clothing store, and you’re the last one on duty. You must do your tasks: Clean the store, tidy the racks, and keep an eye on the dressing rooms... Something is going on in there...

Do you have the answer for all questions? Then hurry up and play the ultimate Football Cup quiz SPORT 1 Live : Duel and boast your knowledge of football. Together, they cooperate to solve the puzzle of restoring the star's power so she may be able to leave."

fields.description: Grim is a horror game inspired from Taiwanese folklore “Aunt Tiger”. The player will play in a room-oriented 3rd-person perspective as a “ghost” and will observe the world from fixed camera perspectives to solve puzzles and survive the monster’s pursuit.

Play in the most action packed airborne battles, with easy controls and awesome dogfighting actions! 
Take control of a mighty Sky Hunter and immediately plunge into 8 player ONLINE BATTLES to the death over 5 dangerous locations. Lock on your missiles and UNLEASH HELL on your opponents as you swoop through the arenas in aerial combat. There are several combat modes at random.

fields.title: Dungeons and Dinners
fields.description:
Q: How to become a powerful hero?
A: Fight! Treasure! Open Boxes! Complete quests! -----WRONG
A: Have dinner on time, keep balanced diet, exercise, keep in good mood. -----RIGHT
In this game, you are a explorer who explore a mysterious dungeon. You get the material from monsters, get the receipies from people, and make food. Keep eating , keep balanced diet, keep strong ---- and explore the secret of this dungoen!

fields.title: Cyber Police ESWAT
fields.description: The game is a sidescrolling platformer similar to Shinobi. The game is set in the near future, where the player controls a blonde police officer named Duke Oda who, over a series of levels, turns into the cyborg E.S.W.A.T. At first, as a rookie member of the Cyber Police force in the city of Liberty, the player has to clean the streets of an overwhelming crime wave and terminate the most wanted criminals. fields.title: Cursed Presence
fields.description: Cursed Presence is a first-person psychological horror, paranormal, and survival horror story where grief opens the door to the supernatural. Explore, solve puzzles, and escape from ghostly entities, guided only by a bell that detects evil and defending yourself with limited resources.

fields.title: Night is Coming: Wrath of the Woods
fields.description: Survival strategy game set in a world inspired by Slavic mythology and the nature of Eastern Europe. Build your settlement, protect its dwellers, and help them prepare for the coming Darkness.

fields.title: Qwerty Garden
fields.description: Qwerty Garden is a cozy typing game where every keystroke grows flowers on your keyboard. Harvest, sell, and buy rarer seeds to expand your garden, then prestige to earn more from every bloom.

fields.title: MeiQi:Story
fields.description: Collect new clues and solve new cases in the latest game in the "Meiqi" series. The new chapter "Story" takes place after the pendulum case. Liu Qingchun mustered the courage to walk into Wang Yong's house.

fields.title: Sea of Dreams
fields.description:
You wake up alone aboard the boat named the Sea of Dream. Strange things happen. Baggage everywhere, traces of blood. But no one. You are alone. Your goal is simple, find help. For this, you will have to explore the ship and solve puzzles in order to move forward. And maybe understand what happened.

Will you survive the Sea of Dreams? Find a way to escape from this dream that has turned into a nightmare.

fields.description: Forge Quest is a dungeon crawling rpg set in a voxel world. Explore the land full of chickens on a light hearted quest to become a hero. Delve deep into the randomly generated dungeons to battle monsters, find treasure and craft your equipment. Invite your friends to join your world and help you in your adventure.

AFL Evolution 2 is taking AFL gaming to new heights with more features than ever before!

fields.description: C.Y.S.M.A. is a third-person action about a man lost in the maze. You will die. Not just eventually, but it keeps happening often. And after every death.. it will happen again...

fields.description: Conduct This! Is a railway management game developed by Northplay. Deliver passengers safely to their destination without crashing into any traffic. There are various real-life and fun fictional train models to unlock as you get further in the game!

fields.title: Steel Eagle
fields.description: Steel Eagle is a reference to the 80's and 90's shooters. Your task is to reach the landing pad at the end of the level, destroying as many enemy units as possible, for which you collect points that can be exchanged for force and strength, which allows you to upgrade your “Steel Eagle”.

fields.title: Superspy Steve
fields.description: Play as Steve, future superspy and lady's man, whose run into a bit of bad luck in his life. But you're Superspy Steve, and nothing can stop you. Conquer those debts, turn around your uncle's business, make your mark with the ladies in town, and take down a criminal enterprise.

fields.title: Remembrance
fields.description: Step into the fractured mind of a dying scientist in Remembrance, a mind-bending VR puzzle adventure. Piece together broken memories, uncover devastating truths, and decide the fate of a world teetering on the edge of collapse. Will you save humanity?

fields.title: God of War Ragnarök: Digital Deluxe Edition
fields.description:
God of War: Ragnarök is the ninth instalment in the God of War series and the sequel to 2018's God of War. Continuing with the Norse mythology theme, the game is set in ancient Norway and features series protagonists Kratos, the former Greek God of War, and his young son Atreus. The game kicked off the events of Ragnarök, where Kratos and Atreus must journey to each of the Nine Realms in search of answers as they prepare for the prophesied battle that will end the world.

fields.title: Daemon
fields.description: Wander the remains of a lost outpost of a dying civilization. Persist or perish. It is of little consequence.

fields.title: Maze Lovers Memorial
fields.description: ​Guide a marble through 80 physics-based puzzles set in an atmospheric cemetery. Each solved maze brings flowers and a dad joke to the tombstone, viewing death in a lightening and natural way. A meditative game about movement, memory, and a positive view of the acceptance of death.

fields.title: Monster Ops 2
fields.description: NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim! Black Ops soldiers Wraith and Tide know they must count on each other to survive. Will their bond as battle-brothers evolve into something more? Monster Ops: Military Special Forces Hunting Rogue Monsters!

fields.title: AsteroidTD
fields.description: Try to survive in infinite asteroid cloud as long as possible in reworked tower defence style. FInd your own playstyle and beat your own records or chillout with original ambient soundtracks. Build, explore, think - everything to create your own colony in this cold space.

fields.title: Christmas Horror
fields.description:
Merry Christmas!

Santa Claus is ready to take over your soul and gain a few more years of life. He only needs two days to get all the resources he needs for the ritual, so this is your time to escape!

You can escape on your own or finish off Santa, it's up to you, but we don't know how to finish him off yet... Just make sure he don't catch you or he will just make your life difficult.

fields.title: QLewds
fields.description: QLewds is a 3 vs 3 online multiplayer clash in a large 2D arena. The game aims to bridge aspects of MOBAs, Metroidvanias, 2D Platformers, and Brawlers into a novel gaming experience.

fields.title: Starseed
fields.description:
Starseed aims to slightly twist the peaceful, calming farm sim archetype. "A farm sim with dark undertones and an isolated atmosphere" - would be a fitting description.

It is still, in sense, a peaceful sim without combat, but this time there's no relationships to build, your interactions are with your helper robots and with mission control back on Earth. You are millions of miles from the people you're trying to save.

fields.title: Bhop up!
fields.description: A bug that became a game mechanic.You will find yourself in an incomprehensible, abstract world, among flying islands and various biomes, in the setting of the Middle Ages.

fields.title: Time Flipper
fields.description: Press one button to switch between timelines, this is your time-flip device, use it to find the missing people and convince them to follow you. Lead them out by switching the world state. Enemies will attack you but you carry no weapons, escape the violence by switching between timelines.

fields.title: Ancient Sacrifice
fields.description: A card battle game with a tealtime + deck building system. In a world where humans are turned into cards, players fight through the story of their revenge against the empire with cards.

fields.title: Curse of Argentum
fields.description: Investigate, explore and fight your way through a cursed manse to find the keys to your escape. Cast spells with the power of Argentum; manage limited resources, and navigate with a classic fixed-camera perspective while you solve puzzles and defend against cursed creatures.

fields.title: Pixel P.I.
fields.description:
Pixel P.I. is a detective game that allows you to ask questions by typing in order to unlock answers from witnesses or suspects.

It follows Pixel, a hacker detective who lost her recent memories and is going over past police cases trying to find any clue about her missing past.

fields.title: Spitkiss
fields.description:
Spitkiss is a trippy story of boundless and unconventional love, told through precision platforming.You play as the spitkissers, sending messages of love and hope back and forth the only way you can: precisely navigating spitballs through a variety of carefully crafted platforming stages. For those truly dedicated to the cause of love there will be extra challenges and additional ways to play each level.

The game includes themes of polyamory and genderfluid/non-binary identities on two layers.

fields.title: Great Again
fields.description: A survival roguelike game where you avoid and kill zombies, save serum, and rescue hostages with your dogs Abbey and Amy.

fields.title: Shot in the Dark
fields.description: Armed with nothing but a six gun the lone bandit will need a quick hand and a sharp eye to fend off the nightmares lurking in the dark.

fields.title: Text Your Life
fields.description: Who did you kiss that night? Text Your Life is a mobile phone chat simulator that lets you put yourself in the shoes of our protagonist, a female university student with a group of eccentric friends and a love life that has suddenly turned somewhat... complicated.

fields.title: Mabinogi Mobile
fields.description: Made by Naak, "G1 to G3" producer of original PC mabinogi. Mabinogi Mobile embarks on amazing adventures, build lasting friendships or even find romance in this unique social MMORPG, where a welcoming community with thousands of devoted players await! Whoever you are, or whatever your heart’s desire, come express it in Mabinogi Mobile and start living your fantasy life!

fields.description: DownhillVR is the ultimate virtual reality mountain biking video game that brings the thrill of extreme downhill racing right to your living room. fields.title: Open Fishing 2
fields.description: Open Fishing 2 is a chill open world fishing game. Fill out a book with 115 fish species, meet friendly fish gods, sail the oceans with your boat, cook, draw your own map, and enjoy fishing without worries.

fields.title: One Way Ticket
fields.description:
I was heading for a new life and my train brought me here. Nice town: friendly people, corn cuisine, mysterious architecture...

So why am I sure that I need to get out of here as fast as possible?

fields.title: Derailed
fields.description:
Embark on an epic journey through a world shattered by the apocalypse, where your decisions shape the fate of humanity.

In this pulse-pounding adventure game, you take control as a fearless train driver, navigating a wilderness teeming with danger. Survival is the only rule, and every choice you make could spell the difference between life and death.

fields.title: FNaF: Project Lockdown
fields.description: Dock to a space station with deadly animatronics and try to get out alive.

fields.title: The Spewnicorn
fields.description: Build the ultimate deck of cards and wield it to defeat the Gatekeepers! A cute and colorful roguelike full of fantastical whimsy!

fields.title: AereA
fields.description:
AereA is a music themed Action RPG in which you play as one of Great Maestro Guido’s disciples and explore Aezir; a floating island that was broken into pieces. Your mission is to find and return the nine primordial instruments to restore balance and peace to the world. You have to find your way through all parts of the scattered islands; complete quests, solve puzzles, defeat bosses and discover the truth behind the islands. Will you be able to return the nine primordial instruments?

fields.description: Final Fantasy XIII‑2 is a story-driven JRPG that blends fast-paced, party-based combat with time-travel exploration. Lead a dynamic duo across branching timelines and varied environments, recruit and customize powerful allies, and refine strategies through real-time command combos, monster collection, and layered progression systems that reward experimentation and replay.

fields.title: Cathode Ray Tube Amusement Device
fields.description:
The cathode ray tube amusement device is the earliest known interactive electronic game to use a cathode ray tube (CRT). It is a device that records and controls the quality of an electronic signal. The strength of the electronic signals produced by the amusement device is controlled by knobs which influences the trajectory of the CRT's light beam. The device is purely electromechanical and does not use any memory device, computer, or programming.

fields.title: Pet Cemetery
fields.description: In the quiet woods of Illinois, a regular guy's peaceful country life takes a sinister turn after an accidental death sets off a bizarre chain of events. As he navigates the mysterious consequences, the secrets of the woods slowly unravel, revealing an eerie connection between lives. Brace yourself for a journey into the heart of rural Illinois, where a single mistake leads to a chilling and enigmatic tale that blurs the line between life and death.

fields.title: Thalassa: Edge of the Abyss
fields.description: Uncover the mystery of Thalassa, a first-person psychological drama set under the sea. Ill-fate has fallen on your former crew and friends and it’s up to you to find answers onboard the wreckage. Experience the melancholic underwater journey of human stories facing life and loss.

fields.title: Amadeus: A Riddle for Thee - Episode 1: Waltz
fields.description: Amadeus: A Riddle for Thee is a linear narrative Visual Novel + Adventure game, heavily inspired by Umineko When They Cry thematically, and Professor Layton aesthetically.

fields.title: Brutalismus: Dystopia
fields.description: A short, atmospheric walking simulator where brutalist architecture becomes the labyrinth of a decaying mind. Inspired by David Lynch's work, explore vast concrete spaces and unravel the story of an architect lost in his own creation.

fields.title: 81diver
fields.description:
In the world of Shogi (Japanese Chess), there are professional players who make their living at the game and gamblers who play Shogi for money. In Hachi-One Diver, gamers take the latter tack and play Shogi against an assortment of opponents who vary in their level of skill and attitude.

fields.title: Brixby
fields.description: Join Brixby, the block-headed hero, on his quest to stop Shadowblock and his Greyblock minions from taking over the land. Run, Jump, & Stomp your way through the many different terrains of The Golden Block Kingdom and save Princess Goldie Bloxx.

fields.title: The Grid
fields.description: The Grid is a 2000 arcade game by Midway. It is a third person shooter which consists of a super-violent television game show hosted by a Smash TV-like host. The game centres around deathmatches. Players control their character using a joystick with a trigger for shooting, a top button for jumping and trackball for aiming. The object of each match is to accumulate the most points by eliminating other opponents. Local multiplayer with up to six players is possible by linking up multiple cabinets.

fields.title: Chop Suey
fields.description:
Chop Suey is a martial arts fighting game developed by Adam Billyard for the Atari 8-bit family. It was published in 1985 by English Software. Antic Software published the game in the US. The title is a repurposing of the name of the American Chinese dish chop suey.

fields.title: Pas's restaurant
fields.description: In a fantasy world, become magical cat Pas. Run your restaurant, serve creatures, make friends. Explore mazes, map them, find hidden food to enrich your menu. Meet friends, hear their stories. Pas's Restaurant eagerly awaits you to co-write this warm fantasy chapter.

fields.title: Taiker
fields.description: "Taiker is a platformer RPG. Peggy and her robot assistant Chopy will explore various area. Obtain skills to beat enemy and solve puzzles."

fields.title: Asteroid Patrol
fields.description: Bang bang! Shoot raining asteroids, dodge attacks of flying insects and battle against huge weird monsters! Gain exp, level up, pick perk and then rinse & repeat. Story? Nobody cares. If you are looking for a difficult and punishing game, don't leave without playing this one.

fields.title: Potion Craft
fields.description: Potion Craft is an alchemist simulator where you physically interact with your tools and ingredients to brew potions. You're in full control of the whole shop: invent new recipes, attract customers and experiment to your heart's content. Just remember: the whole town is counting on you.

fields.description: The titans who hold the sky are about to drop it. A trio of heroes: beautiful and clever Leada, mighty Protus and nimble Adoris embark on a quest to help the giants...

fields.description: Evolve your creature to survive Yggsdrasil! You are a newborn blob at the base of the divine tree. Collect legs, arms, tails, wings and other parts, then combine them in your own body to become the optimal creature!

fields.description: Schwerpunkt is a World War 2 military simulation game. Take control of hundreds of units over a large frontline, making daring manoeuvres to push your enemy back. Fight in one of the scenarios given or make your own in the map maker.

fields.description: Buy Low Sell High is a stock market game made to be easy to learn, fast-paced, and fun. The goal is to make as much money as you can starting with just $5,000. Good luck, have fun!

Serious Sam 3: BFE is a first-person action shooter, a glorious throwback to the golden age of first-person shooters where men were men, cover was for amateurs and pulling the trigger made things go boom.

Serving as a prequel to the original game, Serious Sam: The First Encounter, Serious Sam 3 takes place during the Earth’s final struggle against Mental’s invading legions of beasts and mercenaries.

You're Johann, and one night, you decided to order a cat from shady website. However, when the cat arrives a few days later, it's definitely NOT a normal cat.

Enter magical worlds through colorful paintings and meet a host of fantastic characters that will help you on your quest in Drawn: The Dark Flight. Only someone with the power of imagination can unravel the mysteries of the three beacons, and save a future queen that will bring hope back to a people!

Is this enough? What even is a game? How much interactivity do you need? Are games art? Are there TOO many axolotls in this game?

fields.title: Sol Hemochroma
fields.description:
An adaptation of a lost, 1980s CBC classic film (that could've been): an enticing, alchemical conspiracy in the Canadian steeltown. Four teenagers confront the basement sickness of the town manor: and their leader seems so different, so driven, suddenly... 
 
Who will you forge friendships with? And what will you decide to do, when the time comes to be a hero? Can blood save a society? And what have movies actually taught you?

fields.title: Brave Dungeon: The Meaning Of Justice
fields.description: A sequel that inherits the basic system of the previous Brave Dungeon. You can play in different stories and different systems with the scenarios of the three protagonists.

fields.description: Make your blood run cold... with this spooky match-3 adventure! A scourge has taken over the kingdom and destroyed its strongholds. Traverse a dark land full of haunted horrors! Keep evil at bay in 90 enormous levels designed to delight and fill you with fright.

fields.description: Paris Nights is a 2008 game developed and released by Gameloft for the J2ME platform. It is part of the Nights series by Gameloft.

fields.description: Two supercomputers orbit each other deep in space, temporarily offline. A blue-collar techie lands his spacecraft on the surface, and disembarks. His mission: to return power to all four cores and reactivate the data beam.

fields.description: This is a strategy game that simulates the construction of villages in the 70s, in which you are a prestigious village leader who leads the people to create a prosperous and happy village from a wasteland.

fields.description: Franchise Hockey Manager returns for the 2019-20 season with plenty of additions to the deepest, most authentic hockey strategy gaming experience you can find. Choose one of 32 leagues around the globe and select a team to guide to glory, including a chance at the ultimate prize, the Stanley Cup®.

fields.description: Elva has arrived at our planet with one mission: show us how to save Earth, how to clean cities, mountains, the sea, and how to save animals and forests. Ready to save Earth?

fields.description:
You close your eyes and when you open them again, you wake up in a new world full of magic.
Decide for yourself whether you prefer, to fly on the back of an eagle or would you rather be the pilot.
This game is perfect after a hard day's work.
Try this game, put Oculus Rift on and relax .

Welcome to Cat Clicker! This addictive and fun game tests your reflexes and clicking skills. The goal is simple: click on the cat to collect points and activate bonuses. Featuring a retro 8-bit design and vibrant music, Cat Clicker offers a casual gaming experience perfect for all audiences.

fields.title: Fracture the Flag
fields.description:

Expand your territory by collecting resources and planting your flags. Some territory is rich in resources other has tactical and strategic value. Destroy your opponents flags to remove their claim and make your own.

fields.description: Defend the Catalyst Crystal against adorable yet menacing bugs in The Catalyst Acolyte. Strategically construct defenses in handcrafted levels, aided by helpful items every 10 waves. Engaging gameplay and charming visuals make for an addictive tower defense adventure.

fields.title: Tic-Tac-Toe
fields.description: Tic Tac Toe is a BASIC implementation of the familiar strategy game, where each player attempts to form a line of either noughts or crosses through the 3x3 game board. Two human players may challenge each other, or one may test his wits against the computer (the human player always goes first). When playing against the machine, its degree of cunning depends on the chosen skill levels: "basic", "more difficult" or "most difficult".

fields.title: Can I Get an Iced Coffee with Breastmilk!?

fields.title: Showdown in 2100 A.D.

Each player has to hit his opponent ten times in order to win. At each hit, both players get their guns reloaded. They can also reload their guns anytime by taking the hidden bullets in the tree that matches their outfit

fields.title: Mega Man 10
fields.description: The 8-bit old-schoolers of the world have spoken. And boy, did they do so decisively. When Capcom released the NES-style Mega Man 9 back in 2008, they did it as a piece of one-off fan service, and no matter how good the game was (and it was very, very good), no one expected another 8-bit offering in the core series. And yet, here it is. Mega Man 10 can be found on WiiWare, PlayStation Network and Xbox Live Arcade in all of its retro glory. And, it, too, is very good.

This particular version was designed to run from a 16KB cartridge (although there are also tape and disk versions available to download as well).

The game was developed as an entry for the RGCD C64 16KB Cartridge Game Development Competition (2011), and the name C64anabalt was suggested

fields.title: Prototype 2
fields.description:
Prototype 2 is an open-world action game published by Activision and developed by Radical Entertainment. It's a direct sequel to Prototype and was announced at the 2010 Spike Video Game Awards.

The events of Prototype 2 takes place in New York City, now known as New York Zero (NYZ), following Sgt. James Heller on his quest to destroy Alex Mercer, after having lost everything and everyone he loved to the Blacklight virus.

For a long time now, Dahlia has lived by herself in the Dollhouse with only the stuffed rabbit Wisker for company. One day the owner of the toys decides to present her with a new companion, a sad clown puppet named Huxley. She's delighted for the company but, as the owner soon realizes, it's not so simple to introduce a new friend to the household.

Help her use her sword and her wits in an intense battle across land, sea and air to free her people. Acquire the magic of the elements to defeat the giant T'Soa bosses, and invoke Sia's shapeshifting power in a final showdown against an unforgiving foe!

Run as far as you can, get your score on the leaderboards, beat your friends!

fields.title: Kong: Survivor Instinct - Titans Edition
fields.description:
Titans Edition features a slipcover with a beast journal book.

When giant monsters fight, no one’s safe. Embark on a thrilling quest of survival in a city that’s become a battleground for Titans. Use the lethal strength of Kong and other monsters to your own advantage in this official Monsterverse game set shortly after the events of Godzilla vs. Kong.

fields.title: James Bond 007: From Russia with Love
fields.description: James Bond 007: From Russia with Love is a video game featuring Ian Fleming's secret agent, James Bond. The game is based on the 1957 novel and the 1963 film of the same name, albeit adding in new scenes to make the game more action-oriented, as well as changing the affiliation of the main villains. Additionally, it features many elements of earlier Bond films to recreate the feel of the era such as the jet pack from Thunderball (1965) and the Aston Martin DB5 that debuted in Goldfinger (1964).

From popular fan-favorite episodes to original in-game episodes, players can experience the magical world of Earth Land and fight with Fairy Tail in the exhilarating story!

Engage in battles with the survival of the ninjas hanging in the balance, seek out and conquer true romance, and achieve success in both love and adventure!

A romantic life with handsome ninjas and feelings of love…who is your Destiny Ninja?

fields.title: Witch Hunter
fields.description:
This game is a porn parody of the animated series W. I. T. C. H. and you will better understand the plot and get more pleasure from the game if you are familiar with this universe.

Although in general, this is not necessary at all.

fields.description: Step into the grease-stained boots of a debt-ridden Patcher in a gritty industrial space station. Diagnose critical failures, strip panels with your automatic vortex drill, and replace complex components to bring massive ships back to life. Restore power, clear the smoke, and pay off your debt.

fields.description:
Jump Straight Up choosing the right path to your new best score!

Tap left or right side of the screen to jump on the next platform. Don't forget to look forward so you can avoid fake paths!

How far can you go?

A game about the struggle to have a conversation while also stuffing your face with food. 
 
You are at an all-you-can-eat hot pot restaurant. You're hungry, and you just want to do nothing but chow down. 
 
But you're here with a friend, and you don't want it to seem like you're only here to eat! 
 
Can you manage to keep up a conversation while cooking and filling your belly?

Numerous urban legends have arisen from here.
On the night of the full moon the waters turn to blood and man faced fish lurk within.

Junior high school students Mayu and Himeno came to Manten Aquarium to investigate these urban legends.
In the beginning it was fun, but then...

They see a glimpse of Mayu’s missing little sister, Mari.
The wheels of fate begin turning as they chase after Mari’s shadow.

Either deplete the opponents' HP or knock them off their icebergs; the last penguin standing wins! The game is the predecessor to Raft Wars, a 2007 Flash game using the same art style, objects, physics, and sound effects.

fields.title: Crazy Penguin Catapult
fields.description: Crazy Penguin Catapult is an iOS action game developed by Digital Chocolate and released on Dec 12, 2008. Gameplay is comprised of multiple missions, each broken up into two parts. The first half involves using a catapult to fling penguins through a gap in the wall. Those penguins that make it through are then brought into the second half, in which the player drops the penguins into an area filled with polar bears. If enough polar bears are hit by the penguins, the missions is completed.

The main game element is controlling the players, making searching passes, and scoring goals.

Bob is an angel ordered by God himself to go and clean up the putrid world of the future. He has been given the power of possession so that he can sneak up on any person, animal or genetically engineered being and leap right into their souls!
The rules are up to you - enjoy the freedom.

fields.description: Weird Shit Is Going to Happen is an adult visual novel where weird shit is going to happen. The game is built around a lot of little side stories. As you are exploring these unusual stories, you will try to build a Harem with girls you meet in these side stories.

Presentiment of Death is a fast-paced story-driven VR adventure of intuitive and aesthetic archery with an unusual passage of time, inspired by one of the best games SuperHot
Completely immerse yourself in the world with a special time dilation system, face robots and fight them because only in your power to stop the madness that is happening inside!
Remember that time is inextricably linked with archery, so get ready to act smart and think ahead

fields.description: The Fall of Gyes is a sci-fi visual novel series with stunning cinematic quality and an intriguing story inspired by classic sci-fi horror movies like The Thing, Aliens or Prometheus with claustrophobic atmosphere where no one knows what is happening or who the enemy is until disaster strikes.

fields.title: Valet Simulator
fields.description: Run your own valet company. Start as a beginner and rise to become the best in town. Park cars with precision, deliver exceptional customer service, and expand your business. Compete with rival valet services and dominate valet market with your top-tier valet skills.

fields.title: Knockout City
fields.description: Team up and duke it out with rival Crews in Knockout City, where epic dodgeball battles settle the score in team-based multiplayer matches. Throw, catch, pass, dodge, and tackle your way to dodgeball dominance!

fields.title: Z-Exemplar
fields.description: Z-Exemplar is a side-scrolling shooter in the tradition of R-Type, Gradius, Nemesis and other classic arcade games from the past. Borrowing its aesthetic from the computers of yesteryear (specifically the Sinclair ZX Spectrum) Z-Exemplar combines bright, bold, 8-bit pixel art with frantic action and an epic mission to conquer a galaxy of almost 1000 planets.

fields.description: NTE: Neverness to Everness is a supernatural open-world RPG developed by Hotta Studio. You'll join the crew at Eibon, a rundown antique shop that keeps the lights on by taking Anomaly commissions from anyone willing to pay. fields.description: What A Legend is a hand-drawn sandbox adult visual novel with 2D animations and a large cast of female characters to seduce and romance. You play as a young man who has a special gift that might be the key to save the kingdom from its corrupt leaders.

fields.title: Scraper: First Strike
fields.description: Scraper: First Strike is a VR shooter game with RPG and exploration elements. Created and Imagined by Jim Ivon, Scraper: First Strike uses UE4 to deliver gamers into the year 2076, where they must battle renegade robots in high-rise skyscraper complexes.

fields.title: Beholder: Complete Edition
fields.description:
A totalitarian State controls every aspect of private and social life. Laws are oppressive. Surveillance is total. Privacy is dead. You are a State-installed manager of an apartment house. The State requires you to spy on your tenants, and report any illegal or subversive activity. However, you can also choose to keep the information to yourself, or use it to blackmail the residents, resulting in a multitude of choices and endings. 
 
Also includes: Blissful Sleep DLC

fields.title: Super Puzzle Fighter II Turbo
fields.description:
The game's title is a parody of Super Street Fighter II Turbo (or Super Street Fighter II X in Japan), as there are no other Puzzle Fighter games, and the game includes music and interface elements spoofing the Street Fighter Alpha and Darkstalkers games. It was a response to SEGA's popular Puyo Puyo 2 that has been sweeping Japanese arcade.

A HD-remake version titled Super Puzzle Fighter II Turbo HD Remix, is available for purchase on Microsoft's Xbox Live Arcade and Sony's PlayStation Network

The game utilizes the Nunchuk accessory for the Wii Remote, for basic attacks and for special attacks that require specific movements from both items. The Classic controller and GameCube controller are also compatible with the game.

fields.title: UAZ Racing 4x4
fields.description: UAZ is not just another model amongst other all-terrain vehicles – it‘s a real legend of the Russian motor industry. These unique cars can go places where no man has ever even heard of the word “road”! The first Russian SUV driving simulator “UAZ RACING 4x4” is dedicated solely to this car, UAZ. Now you can show off your outstanding off-roader in the most severe durability tests and ride the really impassable roads, one of the most remarkable and famous Russian phenomena since ancient times.

fields.title: Sphere vs. Gravity
fields.description:
Sphere vs Gravity is a physics-based puzzle platformer that challenges your reflexes skills where you navigate through dynamic, gravity-defying environments.

Be prepared—this game is hard and requires time to adapt.

fields.description: Handgun Football shatters physics: FPS meets soccer brawl. Revolvers, shotguns blast the ball into rival goals. Solo vs AI, slide from chill to hell; .LAN or global 2,3,4-teams,up to 12 players. Classic gravity or zero-g space variants. One shot flips the match.

fields.title: BobasQuest
fields.description: Welcome to the exciting world of Bobas Quest, a fun pixel art platformer where you have to make nimble jumps and complete levels using teleportation.

fields.title: A Walk Through Echoes
fields.description: Accompany an old blind man on his journey in this challenging auditory platformer game. Test your precision platforming skills, reflexes, memory, and puzzle solving in order to progress.

fields.title: Vietnam War
fields.description: Open world single-player FPS. Command your squad in battle across jungles, hills and villages of Vietnam. Fight as U.S or Vietcong. Vast arsenal of weapons and 50+ vehicles

fields.title: Kaidi Armed With a Cat
fields.description: A game about a girl, who is armed with her cat as a gun, fighting with aussie animals. This silly game offers you a once in a life time chance to misunderstand life in Australia!

fields.title: Hungry Frog

fields.title: Ember Sword
fields.description:
Ember Sword, a modern rewrite of the games industry business model in favor of the user, and a love letter to MMORPG (Massively Online Role Playing Game) gamers.

Ember Sword had the fast-paced combat of aRPGs, combined with the isometric view and skill-based abilities of MOBAs, set in a persistent MMORPG fantasy universe.

Ikuto has always been able to see things that others cannot, but over time the visions became worse. Glimpses into the horrors of this world made him unable to live a normal life, and so he left behind his family to follow the visions. The crows have led him to Akikawacho, but what awaits him inside?

In this short prequel to Atama set in 1883, you look through the eyes of those around you to explore the village of Akikawacho and avoid being spotted by the monsters that lurk there.

As security you will have to:
Keep an eye on people so they don't steal, which entails searching old ladies, keep an eye out for gypsies (and not so gypsies) stealing from you.

In the game, he uses Mini Bros. to help him. They all have special abilities that vary. Some can be used for lighting dark areas, some can heal Blender's life, and some do other things.

Welcome to Asgaard, a mythical land where Nordic gods dwell. Dive into a fantasy world inspired by Scandinavian legends. Play as the mighty Thor, God of Thunder, face the raging Loki, and help to stop Ragnarok – the mythical end of day.

Wrath of Loki: VR Adventure will allow you to enter a fantasy world, gather magical artifacts, and solve puzzles that epitomize the genre. The beautiful hand-drawn locations, stirring music, and fantastic story will make you feel like you’re part of the legend.

fields.title: Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain
fields.description: Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain is the sequel to Metal Gear Solid V: Ground Zeroes and a prequel to the original Metal Gear. The game has a complex story with long cut-scene sequences, but there are fewer and they are shorter compared to earlier Metal Gear Solid titles. Most of the gameplay mechanics introduced in Ground Zeroes are carried over: it is still an action game and stealth oriented but replaces the linear corridor design from most earlier titles with large open world environments

fields.title: Astar Solis
fields.description: A minimalistic 2D shoot-em-up, based on dodging bullets.

fields.title: Nandome ka no Hajimemashite
fields.description:
Kinou Yumeto lives a hollow existence. He went to a mediocre university, got a job at a mediocre company, and realizes that there’s something missing in his mediocre life.

Then one day he crosses paths with a demon named “Laplace” when everything disappears and he suddenly finds himself 13 years in the past. Before him are familiar friends, a familiar school and a familiar life.

“If I can rewrite the world, perhaps I can change my life as well…?”

Answer classic rock trivia questions as quickly as you can, the faster you answer the higher the cash value. Correct answers lock in the digit code for the vault, 10 correct answers cracks the vault and awards bonus cash.

fields.description: A hardcore pixel horror game with a twist. Guide our lovely maiden though this space filled with horror, where you'll find yourself emerged in the story line. Maybe, you have become her? Or is she becoming you?

fields.title: Excelios
fields.description: Get ready for an exciting 2D platformer adventure, just like games such as Inside and Limbo. In Excelios, you become Lexi, a special character living inside a computer. Join Lexi on this thrilling adventure filled with puzzles, challenges. Can you defeat the bad guy and fix the computer's problems?

fields.title: Seasons of the Samurai
fields.description:
Lead a samurai through a series of puzzles set in the eight provinces of Japan. Control the season and the time of day in order to change the configuration of each level, allowing the samurai a safe passage to the next level. 
 
All puzzles require logic reasoning and good memory skills. New mechanisms appear as you make your way through each prefecture of Japan, increasing the challenge throughout your journey.

fields.description: "Soft Body is a meditative action game where you control two beautiful, gooey snakes at the same time. In the game, you paint the world with your body, and as you do so, the world changes around you and reveals new obstacles and challenges. Although the action is tense, the mood and aesthetic are contemplative and calm."

Welcome to the once glorious empire of Avalon, now clouded by the darkness of the evil Morganna's spells. After defeating Morganna in an intense magical battle, Evelyne, the protector of Avalon, must now cleanse Avalon from the dark curse with her Rune Magic. fields.description:
Pull Dots is a highly addictive puzzle game.

The goal is to clear all colored dots from the board using up to four black dots. Use game bonuses to achieve this goal.

** Game Modes **

Timed Mode:
How fast can you pull the black dot? It's an exciting race against time to clear the board of all colored dots.

fields.description:
Hunter Scope you will shoot, you will fight, and you will win!

Play S.N.I.P.E.R., the latest sniping game where you aim, fight and destroy virtual enemies. Try different types of missions, inspired both by classic rail shooters and modern cover shooters. Fight your way out during day and night, destroy evil forces and unlock new weapons and power-ups.

fields.title: Retr0Mine
fields.description: A modern take on Minesweeper with quality-of-life features. Save your progress, use hints, and customize gameplay settings to your liking. Whether you're a veteran or newcomer, enjoy a polished experience that honors the classic.

fields.title: Good Job!
fields.description: As the clumsy child of a CEO, you must climb the corporate ladder one office-themed puzzle at a time! Complete puzzles in multiple ways as you experiment with the interactive environments—a projector can be wheeled gently through an electric door…or catapulted through the wall. So toil (or tumble) your way to the top and make your father proud!

fields.description: Amalie is a short and surreal RPG Maker game. It follows the story of a girl and an angel who attempts to convince her to commit suicide.

fields.description: Disco Samurai is a unique rhythm combat game in a cyberpunk setting. Challenge your skills by smoothly combining attacks, parries, dashes and other abilities to the beat of the electronic music. Crank up the volume and seize the rhythm of the electrifying soundscape of synthwave and rock!

fields.title: Hexuma: Das Auge des Kal
fields.description: Hexuma: Das Auge des Kal sends you into an old, supposedly haunted mansion, which turns out to be a gateway to six different periods in Earth’s history. Travel from the age of dinosaurs to the distant future and bring back six crystal shards to battle the sinister god Kal.

fields.description: Super Momotaro Dentetsu II is a video game in the Momotaro Dentetsu series of board game-style video games, genre released in 1991 by Hudson Soft for the PC Engine, Game Boy and Super Famicom. The game was only released in Japan. The game was also included in the list of games available for the TurboGrafx-16 Mini in March 19, 2020.

With the wind speed changing, control your cannon to shoot projectiles above the mountains to hit the enemy. You do that by analyzing the information on 3D mini-map.

fields.description:
You embody a fox in captivity in a cyberpunk world. A mysterious divinity sets you free and asks you to join her on a quest to find the last humans in this world. During this adventure you must protect your cub from various threats: irradiated rats, random behaving drones, and dangerous cyborgs. But you must also be smart and memorize your way around the city and solves puzzles to avoid exposing yourself to danger.

fields.description: Step into the arena of Minos Trials, a 2D puzzle-platformer where brute strength and sharp thinking go hand in hand. Control Minos, a not-so-patient minotaur who solves problems with punches, pushing blocks, filling pits, activating pressure plates, and crushing nosy adventurers who insist on stealing his treasure.

fields.title: Eat Colors
fields.description: Eat Colors is a precision platform game, where instead of running and jumping you throw yourself from surface to surface using just the mouse and a fluffy slime that sticks anywhere.

fields.title: DevLife
fields.description: In DevLife you start your career just before hitting 18. It's up to you to choose who you want to be - a graphic designer or maybe a programmer? Will it be a Website design or Mobile Applications? It is up to you to decide! And what if you chose wrong? Well... You will have to live with that!

"My father is the most famous explorer in the dragon world. Two months ago I'v lost contact with him. He was on a unique expedition. I studied his research and followed him to an anonymous isle. I have to find him!" 
 
Follow our little dragon to a mysterious Island. 
Collecting crystals to reveal the path to find the little dragon's father, aka Piggon the Great Dragon Explorer.

fields.title: Frogsong
fields.description: Frogsong is a heartfelt adventure where it's okay to be small. You'll make new friends, explore beautiful environments, and embark on a journey to find your place in the world.

fields.description: Repose is an dark exploration/puzzle game. In Repose, explore, fight, and maintain a healthy sleep schedule as you descend the twisted levels of the corporation that hired you for unknown reasons.

fields.description: Line Defense: Team up in this cooperative tower defense game. Strategize with fellow commanders, deploy powerful towers, and fend off relentless waves. Are you ready for the ultimate challenge in cooperative defense?

fields.title: Toy Story 3: The Video Game
fields.description: Help Buzz, Woody and the rest of the toys ensure no toy gets left behind in the official videogame based on the hit animated movie franchise.

fields.description: Occlude is a ritual disguised as Solitaire; a cosmic-horror card game where the rules are obscured and reality is at stake. Play through cryptic challenges to reveal forbidden lore in this singleplayer narrative puzzle game for the terminally curious. Don’t worry; you can always start over.

fields.description: Unleash Your Fury in a High-Speed Hack-and-Slash RPG! Enter Swords of Blood, a fast-paced free-to-play hack-and-slash RPG featuring razor-sharp controls, explosive combat, multiple game modes, a rich narrative, and stunning visuals.

fields.title: The Hiking Hawk
fields.description:
In a land where snow never melts and the wind sings through frozen cliffs, a determined young hawk sets his eyes on the peak of the tallest mountain.

But this hawk is different from the rest — instead of soaring through the sky, he chooses to climb, jump, and bounce his way to the top.

Armed only with his spring-loaded boots and pure determination, he begins his journey through slippery slopes, crumbling ledges, and ancient frozen ruins.

fields.title: I'll Take You to Tomato Town

fields.description: Anima is a puzzle-platformer in mysterious technological surroundings. Use your controller to move and deconstruct obstacles in an abandoned mining station through two of its robots, Min.I and Andro.ID. Make a path to your goals, run, jump and bounce to discover what became of your creators!

fields.description: QuAaargh is a great game for developing reflex skills, speed, and perceptivity. It features 150 fun randomly generated levels and 140 unique symbols to make each iteration one-of-a-kind. Within each level the player is given a set time limit in which they have to complete the challenge put forward. So be quick and share your score with friends through online leader boards.

fields.title: Pocket Oasis
fields.description: Pocket Oasis is a hand painted gardening game. Decorate balconies in cities around the globe. Watch your seedlings grow, bloom, and harvest your own fruit.

fields.title: Knightmare Tower
fields.description: Break through ceilings, rescue princesses and escape boiling lava as you slash your way to the top of the Knightmare Tower!

fields.description: A fun and simple pixel platforming puzzle game where you play as a small telekinetic knight, and your goal is to escape the dungeon in which you are held. Also has 30 levels and usually takes around 20 mins to an hour to complete.

fields.title: Sushi Pachi Panic
fields.description: An anime-inspired pachinko game featuring the Sushi Girls and minigames!

fields.title: Fortune Cookie
fields.description: Look, there are fortune cookies! Fortune cookie is a click game which won't make you fat. Here you click the fortune cookie and see the words in it.

fields.description: Bird of Passage is a free night ride across Tokyo. By playing it, you will be granted access to the private conversations between a quirky passenger and the taxi drivers he will encounter en route.

fields.title: Unlock the Three
fields.description: Unlock the Three is about a Police,Medic,Security Worker and a Father trying to escape from a monster in locked hospital. Monster is also controlled by a player and each survivor has its own unique skills to perform.Survivors must be collaborate with each other to be able to escape.

fields.title: The End of the Sun
fields.description: The End of the Sun is a first-person exploration and adventure story-based game, embedded in the Slavic world. fields.title: Mythic Mire

fields.title: Uncharted 4: A Thief's End
fields.description: Several years after his last adventure, retired fortune hunter, Nathan Drake, is forced back into the world of thieves. His greatest adventure will test his physical limits, his resolve, and ultimately what he's willing to sacrifice to save the ones he loves.

fields.title: Heroes of Might and Magic II: The Succession Wars
fields.description: Heroes of Might and Magic II: The Succession Wars is a turn-based strategy video game developed by Jon Van Caneghem through New World Computing and published in 1996 by the 3DO Company. The game is the second installment of the Heroes of Might and Magic series and is typically credited as the breakout game for the series. Heroes II was voted the sixth-best PC game of all time by PC Gamer in May 1997.

It is in this harsh, unforgiving world that he must fight to survive… and teach his son to do the same.

It soon becomes clear that this is no ordinary adventure, but a journey full of horror, creepiness, and mystery.

You must stay alive long enough, and cause enough havoc to be noticed by the space police and finaly manage to escape.

fields.description: The Qixia Diary is an original Visual Novel inspired by the food culture of Hangzhou, China. You play as Sheng Sheng—a first-year art student at Yunqi University. High mountains and icy valleys, hot deserts and bottomless pits await you!

Images to draw by connecting the dots are classified into tags as Art, Monuments, Landscapes, Mandalas, Animals, Vehicles and Sports among others.

The game aims to introduce new and unique mechanics and mix-n'-match existing ones from the Sonic series, in order to create a fresh experience.

fields.title: Aerial Raider
fields.description: Embark on an exhilarating journey in Aerial Raider, a nostalgic top-down arcade shooter that combines classic 1980s pixel art with high resolution backgrounds and high-quality modern audio. Step into the cockpit as Commander Kael Riven and take to the skies in a relentless battle against the Varkari, an alien race from a dying sun. Your mission: shoot down waves of foes, navigate through intense aerial dogfights, and uncover a compelling story that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

fields.description: RogueClick is an incremental RPG where you fight creatures, unlock equipment, and vanquish bosses! Click to swing your mighty sword and slay mystical creatures that drop coins and gems. These resources enable you to unlock new equipment to become stronger! Complete quests and play Endless mode to amass even more wealth!

fields.title: Yumemiru Sepia
fields.description:
Pia adores Wither and Wither adores Pia. The two cherish their time together alone, spent on playdates at the park.

It's simple, easygoing - a pleasurable time that they indulge in for as long as the day allows. Pia is allowed to let loose and howl to their heart's content. Yume enjoys Pia's song immersed within nature's own orchestra. Life is lovely... But Pia notices that Yume is troubled.

Can these gentle moments last?

Using a variety of weapons classes you must progress through many varied missions, using your squad members to scout ahead, bomb targets, rescue hostages and ultimately defeat your enemy and free the world.

Gain cash and experience by defeating your enemies. Use this to improve your arsenal, level up your squad and unlock new items to help in your mission.

fields.title: Livber: Smoke and Mirrors
fields.description: A short psychological horror interactive story. Five years after vanishing without a trace, the woman you once called your lover writes from beyond the silence: "I will give birth to your child.” In three acts, descend into a fractured mindscape where obsession, memory, and myth intertwine.

fields.title: Touch
fields.description: Touch is a text-adventure with graphics. It is based on the manga of the same name, which later became an anime series.

fields.title: Medusa's Labyrinth VR
fields.description:
Medusa’s Labyrinth is a short mythological first person horror game set in ancient Greece. It takes myths and legends that have stayed with us for over 2000 years and mix them together in a game that blends horror with stealth into a unique experience.

Pick your path through the abandoned hallways, through winding catacombs and dark chamber to solve the mysteries that lurk within.

Choose input method: teleport or classic FPS. Light your way with a torch or use your bow & arrow as you sneak aro

fields.title: Decaying Delicacy
fields.description: Collect keys to unlock gates to get those delicious delicacies while avoiding strange threats in a 2.5D arcade collection game, or at least that's the game some of the time. Read your diary, or don't. The game has several different endings based on your performance, and a number of alternative paths based on your choices and how you're doing.
