fields.title: A Few Days With: Rebecca
fields.description: Embark on a sensual butterfly-hunting adventure with Rebecca, a charming young woman. In this hidden object game, explore each location to discover what lies beneath Rebecca's enticing layers.

fields.title: 18 Wheels of Steel: Haulin'
fields.description: Life on the road is filled with obstacles. Do you have the juice to go from gearjammer to boss man in the trucking business? Climb in the can and find out!

fields.title: Stickman Master
fields.description: Beat the dark monsters in this fighting game

fields.title: Tentaphage
fields.description: Tentaphage is an adventure 3D platformer with horror elements. You play as the Tentaphage, an anomalous eldritch creature. Swing, grapple, slingshot and possess humans to save your mother and devour humans!

fields.title: Super Grappling Gecko
fields.description: Swing over spikes and pits, find the secrets of a mysterious tree, and overcome difficult challenges as a brave tiny lizard in this small adventure.

fields.title: Shuffle!
fields.description: The world of the gods, demons, and humans have converged, and magic has become the norm. This is the story of the very busy romantic adventure of a boy called “The man who can become either God, Demon, or Human.”

fields.title: Shuffle!

fields.title: Altero
fields.description:
Altero is an atmospheric puzzle platformer game that will tease your brain! Control Adi the voodoo doll and accept to sacrifice yourself in order to team up with your past.

Dive deep into the darkness of the Sorrow forest and rescue the lost souls to find your peace.

fields.title: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - Commander Edition
fields.description: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - Commander Edition includes a base game, an Art Book, Digital OST, Digital Map, and 4 in-game items: Magnificent Plume Hat, Ratcatcher's Goggles, Dashing Cavalier's Gloves, Righteous Exorcist's Bracers.

fields.title: SimCity 3000
fields.description: SimCity 3000, released in 1999 as the third major installment in the SimCity series, continues its successful course as a city building simulation game. In SimCity 3000 new tools have been introduced to create and control the city build-ups. Recreate the world's greatest cities using predefined landscapes such as San Francisco or Berlin and landmark buildings like the Empire State Building or Big Ben. Negotiate and barter with neighbouring cities to strengthen your metropolis and seal contracts

fields.title: Spread Eagle Cross the Block!
fields.description: Play as MC Ride from the band Death Grips as you literally spread eagles across a city block. The master copies of your records are lost in the town, and you don't know who can be trusted, so just FIRE AT EVERYTHING! There are six (technically seven) records lost and when you find one, weird things happen. There is no way to lose this game and there is only one level!

fields.title: Tamarindos Freaking Dinner
fields.description: Tamarindos Freaking Dinner; first-person horror adventure game and the spiritual successor of Baobabs Mausoleum. The second game of the "Jacob Jazz's Treelogy". A mix between A 90's sitcom, Luigi's Mansion & the tabletop game Clue! Featuring hilarious dialogue and stories in the style of the most famous graphic adventures, this is the tale of Macario Macabro, whom no one knew was already dead... On the day that he died.

fields.title: Mom Life Simulator
fields.description: Manage the busy daily life of a caring mother in Mom Life Simulator. Take care of your children, cook meals, clean the house, look after your dog, and find time for your own hobbies while balancing family responsibilities and time management.

fields.description: Crime Life: Gang Wars is a free roaming crime-based beat em up. Urban culture and the Hip Hop lifestyle is the focus of Crime Life: Gang Wars.

fields.description: Have you ever controlled a game without using a keyboard or a mouse? Yes, This is possible. We have developed a Artificial Intelligence-based game that gives you the ability to control the ball's movement and directions via hand movements, the challenge is to gain as many points as possible.

fields.title: Dad Hungry!
fields.description: You're stuck on the island of hunger, and you need to find all the food to escape. However, you come to realize that you're not the only one who's hungry…

fields.title: The Sims
fields.description: The Sims is a life-building simulation with emphasis on intimate details of individual characters rather than expansion of an entire society or civilization. You are in control of nearly every aspect of the lives of the individuals who make up your chosen population in the neighborhood. Characters are developed from the ground up and you infuse and mold them with personalities, looks, desires, moods, urges, living arrangements, career and personal choices, life styles, and reactions.

The story explores themes of choice, loss, and the pursuit of one's future while navigating complicated relationships.

The surge in digital currencies makes you an overnight millionaire. How will you choose your path and carve out a unique life story?

fields.description: HYPERDRIVE is a fast paced Sci-fi action flight sim, combining the infinitely looping gameplay of a roguelike, along with the combat and controls of classic spaceship combat. Avoid obstacles, and take down enemy ships in high speed space combat, all while making as many deliveries as possible!

fields.description: Retrowave Rider is a mash up of Geometry Dash and Guitar Hero. Dive into synthwave worlds filled with retro-inspired visuals and smooth synth sounds, and experience this journey with all of its trials and glories.

fields.title: Killer Bunny
fields.description: Killer Bunny is an action-based platformer where players will traverse wild lands as a bunny protagonist, hunting the wretched spiders and snakes that killed their parents. At the end of the game, the bunny will face “Daddy Snake” and “Mommy Spider” — the primordial beings responsible for all spider and snake spawn.

fields.title: Chasing the wind
fields.description: Chasing the wind is a casual level game and parkour game, accompanied by laid-back music, constantly flight forward. Faced with various obstacles, you need to consider the way to pass the game skillfully or flexibly. Of course, smooth levels are the fun of this game.

The player assumes the role of Toya Kagari, a resident of Shin Yokozaki City and a sophomore at the prestigious Hakuou North Academy.

fields.title: Californium
fields.description:

When you Focus, your Bean will Focus.

fields.title: Platform Hell
fields.description: Platform Hell is a brutally challenging 2D platformer that will test your reflexes, patience, and precision. Navigate through deadly obstacle courses filled with spikes, moving platforms, and timing-based traps in this pixel-perfect jumping experience.

fields.description: A chilling homage to retro gaming – Rediscover the magic of classic games and retro platformers with a terrifying twist. SPOOKY PIXEL HORROR combines the beloved aesthetics of vintage 2D pixel games with a deeply immersive horror narrative that will keep you on edge.

fields.title: Lode Runner

You take on the role of a janitor who, in the midst of his solitary routine, begins to experience strange events: children appearing in empty classrooms, shadows watching you from the corners, and a growing sense that something is terribly wrong.

fields.title: SurrounDead Poly Construction
fields.description: SurrounDead Poly Construction is an open-world survival adventure game where players will solve puzzles, collect items, and defeat all enemies to reach the end.

fields.title: Pirates of the Caribbean
fields.description: Pirates of the Caribbean is a role-playing game in which the player takes the role of a pirate who has to grow in skill by fighting, trading and solving quests. The player can buy and upgrade a ship, sign-up a crew, and try to rule the seas of the Caribbean.

fields.description: Battle epic bosses, loot powerful gear, find loyal pets, and forge your build through skill trees, keystones, and runes in an ever-evolving endgame.

fields.description: Alchemistress Vivi is a code-breaking logic puzzle that should take approximately 20 to 25 minutes to complete. In each level, up to 6 magic items must be arranged in a certain order to cast powerful spells. Every try results in a feedback that helps the player to eventually find the right sequence. But watch out: There's only a limited number of lives available for this.

fields.title: Corner Cards
fields.description: Corner Cards is a relaxing corner-window idle card-collecting game where you open booster packs, complete card sets, and upgrade your booth to attract more customers and fans alike!

fields.description: Zero Zero: Perfect Stop is a train driving game for Playdate where you use the crank to control the train's throttle and brakes. Stop in the right place, at the right time. Maintain your timetable as you glide through scenic Yamanashi.

fields.title: War Era Lumberjack
fields.description: "War era Lumberjack" is a mini-game in the process of making a simulation game during the Warring States period in Japan.

fields.title: Tax Evasion
fields.description: An action filled roguelike, where you climb the floors of the IRS headquarters to reclaim what is rightfully yours... Your money. Take down your enemies. Buy items with their money. And climb the floors. Unlock new characters and abilities to approach this office building in many different ways.

fields.title: Mysterious Space
fields.description: Mysterious Space was originally created for the 2014 7-Day Rogue-Like competition, but has received many updates since! It features many familiar rogue-like elements - including potions, equipment, and procedurally-generated worlds - but is ultimately a side-scrolling action shooter.

fields.description: Buckle-up for an epic road trip through a colorful world of puzzles and adventure. Use driving skills and puzzle solving abilities to find missing artifacts and piece together the broken world of Blocktaria.

fields.description: Casual arcade with clicker elements! Defend the Kingdom from invasion! Take control of the last surviving tower and a group of archers to stop the army of evil creatures.

fields.description:
Gates of Zendocon is a side-scrolling shooter very similar to the original arcade shooter of this type, Scramble. Unlike Scramble, however, there are 51 game areas in total, but the player fights through a subset of them through branches, choosing the next area to visit.

Some aliens will join you when shot (power-ups). Alien bases in each area allow you to repair your weapons and shield, but landing at the wrong time will cause your ship to explode and lose all power-ups.

Legends of Iskaria is a 2D RPG which claims to be non-linear and immersive. 
The game is mainly focus on story-telling, dialogs and exploration. 
Built with love for 16bits graphics, it takes up some components of classic RPGs while playing with genre codes.

fields.description:
Apollo Justice Turnabout Substitution is a fancase developed for PyWright. 
The game is set shortly after "Turnabout Succession" and was intended to act as a fifth case to the original game. 
 
When the city's most famous judge gets arrested on suspicion of murdering an infamous serial killer, he has no one to turn to but rookie attorney Apollo Justice. 
But is he up to the task? Can he find the truth on his own? And, above all, can he face it?

fields.title: Library
fields.description:
Library is a cute game about hanging out and throwing stuff at your new friends!
Explore a cute library in first-person and enjoy the friends and rooms you come across.

fields.title: Virtual Chess
fields.description: VirtuaChess is the commercial version of the Écume and Cumulus 2 chess programs (which finished second in the blitz tournament in Munich and which tied 2nd/3rd in the 7th World Championships in Madrid). It runs on a PC with MS-DOS and can use all of the available memory for its hash tables. It has a splendid graphical interface written by the French firm Titus. Most of the chess engine is written in 32 bit assembler, and the program includes dynamic evaluation of king safety and pawn structure.

fields.description: Delta Light is a retro Arcade strategy/puzzle game where you draw lines to remove parts of the field while enemies try to stop you. Combine your speed and insight to out maneuver and puzzle your way around the enemies to complete the many levels! Pick it up and have a go!

fields.description: A vibrant, white-haired beauty, but her true identity is actually a timid, short-haired, glasses-wearing girl?! I'm still dating her! A 200% sweet college romance! Dates, hand-holding, hugs, kisses, and marriage after graduation!

fields.title: Pokey Ball
fields.description:
Try to poke and flick your ball as high as you can.

How high can you go?

- An epic campaign with massive bosses

fields.description: A short atmospheric psychological horror game. Locked in a corporate contract, you must decide who lives and who dies based only on details that can be written down about them. How will you justify your choices?

fields.title: Final Fantasy XIV Online
fields.description:
Take part in an epic and ever-changing Final Fantasy as you adventure and explore with friends from around the world. Final Fantasy XIV Online is the 2013 relaunch of the massively multiplayer online role-playing game that takes the wonder of the FF legacy and expands it, allowing you to explore the realm of Eorzea like never before in a Final Fantasy game.

Forge friendships, mount chocobos, and board airships as you and your companions create your own unique stories in Eorzea. Adventure alone

Mamono Slayer is a mini Metroidvania developed and published by Skipmore as a free browser game.

fields.title: Fallen Saint Yhoundeh
fields.description: One day, Yhoundeh suddenly finds herself summoned to a mysterious temple, where she learns that she is the 'Elk-Saintess' of prophecy who must save the Kingdom of Nyarlaza from the tyrannical rule King Sadogui.

fields.title: Elven Rivers: The Forgotten Lands - Collector's Edition
fields.description: Celene and her brave teammates have already earn a reputation for themselves: this is why they were chosen to be the first group to explore the neighbouring continent of beastmen.

fields.description:
Morikomori Life is a social and simulation game featuring Ghibli-style artwork, with a core experience that is based on farming and social relationships. The main character, Kaon, receives a secret letter from her grandmother, which leads her back to her childhood hometown of Komori, a quiet village far from the hustle and bustle of the city, where she experiences a healing life.

The Japanese-style paradise-like village is depicted using 3D toon shading to reproduce realistic textures, bringing

fields.title: Hit The Clock
fields.description: Hit The Clock is a simple arcade game where you shoot the hour hand of a moving clock to hit the next one. Each hit destroys the previous clock and increases the challenge with faster spins and smaller targets. Tap at the right moment to progress, and finish within the time limit to earn a star.

fields.title: Kittypocalypse: Ungoggled
fields.description: Kittypocalypse is an in-depth, strategic tower defense game. Across a diverse range of environments, defeat the hordes of evil alien kitties and salvage what's left of your home planet.

fields.title: First Customer
fields.description: Welcome to paradise company! "First Customer" is a prologue of the "PARADISE". You were chosen as the first customer of Paradise. Let's go an adventure journey with Risa.

fields.title: Boukyaku no Edicius
fields.description:
She wants to “end” happily ever after...

Saku Koshimizu, the protagonist of this story, is a victim of power harassment and has no courage to commit suicide.

On the day he skipped work, he met a girl who calls herself Nagisa, and they went out on a one-day date.

fields.description: Introducing the ideal shogi game--providing a combination of strength, aptitude, and speed so that you won't have to wait. fields.description: We Have To Let You Go is a puzzle RPG game created from the ground up using the RPG Maker engine. Players will traverse several vibrant worlds interconnected by an engrossing character-driven storyline, and a strategic battle system.

fields.title: Arie: Moonprayer
fields.description: "Arie: Moonprayer" is a storytelling exploration game. Moon is falling, and the world is ending. Diallo, a man who can sense the memories of the gone, has one last mission on earth: Go up to the peak nearest to the moon with his mentor's daughter, find out the truth of this world.

fields.title: Forza Motorsport 2: The Complete Collection
fields.description:
Forza Motorsport 2 brings Microsoft's racing sim series to the Xbox 360 with new tracks, new cars, and an impressive livery editor.

The Complete Collection includes a bonus disc containing additional 43 cars and 2 tracks, originally released as DLC through the Xbox LIVE Marketplace.

fields.title: Boo Bunny Plague
fields.description: Join Bunny and his pals Gunny, Faye, and Ganny on an epic quest to earn enough money to buy himself an Auto-repair unit! Boo Bunny Plague is an action/adventure game featuring a story with wacky musical cinematic scenes. The all original soundtrack has everything from punk rock to opera and feature musicians from Houston Texas.

fields.title: Pinch 50 Renpatsu!!
fields.description: “50 Pinch Barrage” is a highly casual side scrolling action game! With simple controls, the player must use their wits to squeeze by pinch after pinch and escape the mysterious island!*The Free Edition is an original stage in which you can train your action gameplay skills.

fields.title: Pinch 50 Renpatsu!!
fields.description: “50 Pinch Barrage” is a highly casual side scrolling action game! With simple controls, the player must use their wits to squeeze by pinch after pinch and escape the mysterious island!*The Free Edition is an original stage in which you can train your action gameplay skills.

fields.title: Knights and Bikes
fields.description: Knights and Bikes is a co-op action adventure game set in a beautifully hand drawn 3D world. You play as our two heroines, Nessa and Demelza. Nessa is an orphan from the mainland, who has run away to the island searching for her past and her identity. Demelza is a video game-obsessed islander searching for the truth using clues from her favorite game.

fields.description: X-Men Cartoon Maker is a video game tie-in to the 1992 series X-Men. It is an educational game that allows players to create art.

fields.title: Hack Back
fields.description: Breach networks, plant malware, steal secrets, and outsmart digital defenses in a real-time strategy campaign that teaches cybersecurity through immersive, hands-on gameplay—no experience or skills needed!

fields.title: Coin Hunter
fields.description: Fight monsters with coins and descend by elevator. In this first-person roguelike, coins are both currency and ammo — survive while deciding whether to spend or shoot.

fields.title: Manivore
fields.description: He doesn't just hunt to kill. Manivore is not just a murderer, he is an artist. For him, death is not an outcome but a process. Can you uncover the truth within this twisted game, or will you be the next prey?

fields.title: Zen Pinball 2
fields.description:
Zen Pinball 2 launched on PlayStation 4 as a free platform download with a total of 20 tables available as paid DLC. Users can purchase tables inside the Zen Pinball 2 platform, including the following tables and packs at launch:

• Star Wars Pinball
• Star Wars Pinball: Balance of the Force
• Marvel Pinball
• Marvel Pinball:Avengers Chronicles
• Plants vs. Zombies Pinball
• Epic Quest
• Paranormal
• Earth Defense

fields.description: Battle against thousands in HAPPY ZONE! Upgrade characters, unleash drones and airstrikes, collect loot, and outlast 12 players to be the sole survivor. Team up with friends and climb the leaderboard to become a legend!

fields.title: Honey Guardian
fields.description:
Short score-attack shmup in the "caravan" style.

Jenny has two minutes to save her hive from invading insects. Power up her sting shot with honey crystals and shoot invaders coming from all directions! No ads, no pay-to-play, no pay-to-win.

Original game made for Gunner Parade Jam 2022.
Ported to Android for Android Port Jam 2023.

fields.title: Toru
fields.description: Toru is a bullet-hell platformer where absolutely everything that falls into your hands becomes a weapon! Boxes, crystals, bombs and even the enemies themselves! Your success depends only on your skill!

fields.title: Motörhead
fields.description:
As Lemmy you must work your way through some of the toughest scrolling levels ever encountered. You swing your bass and fight through the swarm of Motorhaters, swigging whiskey and collecting the magical Motorhead talismans with the aim of collecting all your drinking buddies/band members and getting on that stage.
It's not all hard work though. At the end of each level you have the chance to mount your chrome and steel steed and race at highly illegal speeds collecting bonuses.

fields.title: Papercut Art Gallery: Nature II
fields.description: An artistic puzzle game inspired by paper cutting art. Piece together fragments of paper cutouts to restore the nature-themed artworks in the gallery.

fields.description: Something’s Cooking… and It’s Not Just the Food.

fields.title: Youmu-Youmu Ball
fields.description:
It's time to do some dexterity and reflex training with everybody's favorite half-human, half-phantom gardener sword girl, Youmu Konpaku!

Help Youmu keep the Yin-Yang orbs in the air for as long as she can with as many slashes as possible.

Try not to drop too many! Or maybe drop a few, it may be helpful!

fields.title: Tomb Raider IV•V•VI Remastered: Deluxe Edition
fields.description:
Play the next series of Tomb Raider adventures in this remastered collection of the Darkness Trilogy.

See the Classic & Remastered Visuals: Play with the original polygonal models or swap to the remastered graphics at any time.

Travel the Globe: Follow Lara Croft around iconic locales including Cairo, Rome, Paris, and many more Experience Lara’s Darkest Adventures: Uncover the secrets of Lara Croft’s past and shed light on the mystery of her disappearance.

fields.title: Jump Super Stars
fields.description: Jump Super Stars is a 2D fighting game for the Nintendo DS. It was developed by Ganbarion and published by Nintendo. The game was released on August 8, 2005 in Japan and accompanied the release of a red Nintendo DS. A sequel, Jump Ultimate Stars, was released in Japan on November 23, 2006.

fields.title: Blast Rush LS
fields.description: Ever played a difficult shmup wishing for just one more bomb? Blast to your heart’s content in Blast Rush LS, a fresh explosive experience with infinite bombs, other powerful abilities, and extra challenges that demand more than just big booms. Escaping an exploding mothership isn't easy, after all!

fields.description: The Round-about Orchard is a super tiny fan project (about 15 minutes of play time!) that reunites some Over the Garden Wall folks (creator Patrick McHale, background artist Levon Jihanian, musicians The Blasting Company, and Elijah Wood is back as Wirt!) to create this nugget of point-and-click adventure gaming!

fields.title: Teabat!
fields.description: Teabat! is a stylish retro 2D adventure with fast, tight controls, and a large interconnected map full of secrets and beautifully constructed set-pieces!

fields.title: The Elf on the Shelf: Christmas Heroes
fields.description: Santa needs you! Become a Scout Elf, gathering Christmas Spirit and dodging obstacles. Pledge to make things merry and be a Christmas Hero!

fields.title: HiPurrLand
fields.description: Hundreds of cats and fifteen brand-new levels await your exploration!

fields.title: Urban Tale
fields.description: Urban Tale is a realistic, vibrant and unique RPG that will allow you to fulfil your dreams, and pursue your most wanted goals in life. You start from scratch, having nothing in the big city where you can meet a lot of people, that can help you throughout your adventure. Your goal is to survive and succeed in life.

fields.title: Fur-Guardians
fields.description:
Fur-Guardians is a traditional platformer game.
It features 16-bit style graphics and old-school music and sound effects.
It's free to download and play with no in-app purchases and no ads.

Create your own furry character and defend the land of Fur-Gardia.
Run and jump through different environments to collect gems and defeat monsters from the Realm of Chaos.

fields.title: Big Bumpin'
fields.description:

A sequel to Street Fighter, Street Fighter II improved upon the many concepts introduced in the first game, including the use of command-based special moves and a six-button configuration, while offering players a selection of multiple playable characters, each with their own unique fighting style and special moves.

Street Fighter II is credited for starting the fighting game boom during the 1990s. Its success led to the production of several updated versions, each offering additional features

fields.title: Tetris Gems
fields.description: Tetris Gems is an all-new Tetris game variant designed to both challenge and entertain puzzle fans. fields.title: Escape from Chernobyl
fields.description:
TRY TO ESCAPE FROM THE HAUNTED AREA OF CHERNOBYL NPP 
Escape from Chernobyl is a survival-horror game taking place in the Chernobyl power-plant complex. It features an initial story-driven part taking place inside the reactor buildings and then turns into an open-world survival with total freedom to explore in a seamless experience: from open spaces to the maze-like corridors of each building and the nuclear unit buildings.

fields.title: Ultimate Ghosts 'n Goblins
fields.description:
Ultimate Ghosts 'n Goblins is the first game in the series to employ 3D graphics, while maintaining much of the 2D gameplay mechanics of the earlier games. It also marks the return of the series' project head, Tokuro Fujiwara.

The game still follows the classic scenario of the heroic knight Arthur battling with demons, but includes a large number of changes.

Use your robots to unlock doors, push away blocks, shift colors, and work as a team to help aid your special black and white robot to the finish!

fields.title: Wreckfest
fields.description: Wreckfest is a racing video game developed by Bugbear Entertainment and published by THQ Nordic. It features demolition derbies and traditional races with a strong emphasis on vehicular damage and realistic physics. The game includes various modes such as career, multiplayer, and custom events. Released in 2018, Wreckfest is notable for its detailed destruction modelling and the strategic depth required in vehicle customisation and handling.
